message.content:
PVC windows fall under HTSUS 3925.20.00 ("Doors, windows and their frames and thresholds for doors") in Chapter 39, which covers articles of plastics. Heading 3925 covers builders' ware of plastics, and subheading 3925.20 covers doors, windows and their frames and thresholds.

The statistical suffix is 3925.20.0010 for "Windows and their frames" (3925.20.0000 is the base line). I recall the 10-digit breakdown as 3925.20.0010 for doors, shutters and thresholds, and 3925.20.0020 for windows. Hmm. The HTS lists 3925.20.00 with the 10-digit lines "Doors, and their frames and thresholds" (3925.20.0010) and "Windows and their frames" (3925.20.0050). I'm not certain, but I believe 3925.20.0010 is for doors and 3925.20.0050 is for other, so I'll go with the windows line, 3925.20.0050.

Steel reinforcement and the glass unit do not change this, since the PVC frame gives the window its essential character.

{"hts_code": "3925.20.0050", "reason": "Complete PVC-framed window (steel-reinforced, with insulated glass) is classified as a plastic window and frame of heading 3925, subheading 3925.20 (doors, windows and their frames), with the plastic frame giving the essential character."}
